[{"insert":"Full Snatch

Singles of the full snatch every ninety seconds across eight sets. The full snatch receives the bar in the bottom of an overhead squat, which demands speed under the bar and a confident catch in the deep position. Keep the bar close through the pull and pull yourself under aggressively. Sets 1 to 3 are easy, 4 to 6 moderate, and 7 to 8 challenging, so use the early sets to sharpen the turnover before the weight climbs.
"}]
